name: dumbbell front squat
description: A squat with dumbbells held at your shoulders. The front load keeps your chest upright and challenges the quads and core.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.
